## HTML File Preview (HH)

The web family's renderer. An HTML file is **both a rendered page and inspectable markup**, so the detailed view shows the document the way a browser would *and* a source view beside it.

### Sandbox posture — read this before changing anything here

The source is fetched with the caller's session and handed to the frame as **`srcdoc`**, so the document renders from an **opaque origin**: no cookies, no storage, no realm session.

```
sandbox = allow-scripts          ← authored behaviour runs
          (NOT allow-same-origin) ← inside the isolation
```

`allow-scripts` **without** `allow-same-origin` is the load-bearing combination. Granting both together would let the framed document reach back into the realm origin with the viewer's session — which is the whole attack this posture exists to prevent. Powerful features are denied outright.

### A fitted cell never mounts a frame

A collection of documents must not each fetch and execute a page. The fitted branch renders a static prose summary built from the **already-extracted metadata**, so a grid of 50 HTML files boots zero frames.


Projected into the four format shells by `FilePreviewStage`, which owns the loading, failure and staleness panes — this component draws content only.
